snippet.title: Cleared Hot – Official Launch Date Trailer | Coming to Steam Early Access November 20
snippet.description:
🚁 Cleared Hot Takes Off November 20!
Get ready for physics-fueled helicopter mayhem in Cleared Hot, where every explosion, rescue, and sling-shot chicken obeys (some) laws of physics.

Customize your chopper, upgrade your loadout, and master the rope-and-magnet system to lift, toss, or drop just about anything on the battlefield.

Early Access Highlights:
Physics-driven mayhem
Upgradeable helicopters
Rope and magnet gameplay
Tactical squad support
Desert, Jungle, and Arctic biomes
Day and night operations

Cleared Hot launches in Steam Early Access on November 20, 2025.
Wishlist now and prepare for takeoff:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1710820/Cleared_Hot/

#ClearedHot #MicroProse #HelicopterGame #IndieGame #EarlyAccess
